events.title: Lectures Begin
events.description: First day of lectures for SS 2026. Check Stud.IP for your room assignments.

events.title: Course Selection Deadline
events.description: Last day to register or deregister from courses via Stud.IP for SS 2026.

events.title: Exam Registration Opens
events.description: Exam registration opens in QIS/PRIMUSS. Don't forget to register for each exam you want to take!

events.title: Exam Registration Deadline
events.description: Last day to register for exams in QIS/PRIMUSS. Missing this deadline means missing the exam.

events.title: Whitsun Holiday (Pfingsten)
events.description: No lectures during Pfingsten holiday week.

events.title: Exam Withdrawal Deadline
events.description: Last day to withdraw from an exam without penalty. After this date, a no-show counts as a failed attempt.

events.title: Exam Period Begins
events.description: Main exam period for SS 2026. Check QIS for your individual exam schedule.

events.title: Re-enrollment Deadline (WS 2026/27)
events.description: Pay semester fee and re-enroll for WS 2026/27 via the student portal. Missing this means exmatriculation.

events.title: Resit / Second Attempt Exams
events.description: Second attempt exams for students who did not pass in the main period.

events.title: Grade Publication Deadline
events.description: Grades for SS 2026 should be visible in QIS by this date.

events.title: WS 2026/27 Lectures Begin
events.description: First day of lectures for Winter Semester 2026/27.
